summary: include_role options: allow_duplicates, apply for task keywords, defaults_from, handlers_from, name, public (false by default), rescuable, rolespec_validate, tasks_from and vars_from.
questions: How do I make include_role variables available to later tasks?
How do I apply become to all tasks in an included role?
Are include_role variables public by default?
What does rescuable do in include_role?

answer_card.title: include_role parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required)
- `apply`: task keywords (e.g. `tags`, `become`) for all role tasks
- `public` (**false**): true exposes vars/defaults to tasks after the include
- `rescuable` (true, 2.21+): include errors become rescuable task failures
- `tasks_from`/`vars_from`/`defaults_from`/`handlers_from` (main)
- `allow_duplicates` (true), `rolespec_validate` (true)
